evals.prompt: Find dengue events in Asia since 2026-06-01, sort them by case count descending, and include the source, quality score, and EPIC detail page.
evals.expected_output: A status-aware Markdown table filtered by disease, continent and date, sorted by cases descending.
expectations: Output warns that the current data source status is degraded before the results.
Every returned record is dengue in Asia and on or after 2026-06-01.
Non-null case counts are sorted descending and nulls appear last.
Results include original source, data quality score and stable EPIC event URL.

evals.prompt: Return influenza records from EPIC as JSON. Include only event_id, event_start_date, disease_id, location, cases, and source; return at most three records.
evals.expected_output: Valid JSON with status metadata and no record fields outside the requested selection.
expectations: Output is valid JSON with data_status, matched, returned and records keys.
Each record contains exactly the six requested fields.
At most three records are returned and all use disease_id influenza.
Status metadata distinguishes data_as_of from source status.

evals.prompt: Query dengue using a nonexistent EPIC records URL with a 0.1-second timeout and no retries. Fail clearly and do not fabricate results.
evals.expected_output: A nonzero exit with an actionable stderr error and no fabricated event records.
expectations: Stderr starts with EPIC query error and names the failed URL.
No event records or success summary are emitted.
